ki.subtitle: Any OpenAI-compatible endpoint works: cloud or local.
ki.apiKeyPlaceholder: Leave empty if the server needs no key
ki.keyringNote: Stored in the system keyring, separately for each endpoint, and only sent to this base URL.

ki.testNeedsModel: Please enter the base URL and model name first.

engine.subtitle: Stockfish runs in the background on this computer.
engine.threadsNote: This many positions are analysed at the same time, each with its own engine process. The native engine needs about 300 MB of memory per process.
engine.nativeMissing: The native engine was not found, the built-in version is active. “pnpm fetch:engine” downloads it.

analyse.subtitle: Controls what the AI explains and how simply it puts it.
analyse.thresholdsInvalid: The thresholds must increase: inaccuracy < mistake < blunder.
analyse.automatic: Brilliant and Great are detected automatically (Multi-PV, piece sacrifices).

training.subtitle: Which of your own errors become training puzzles (Library → Training).
training.blundersHint: Moves that cost a lot – the most important puzzles.
training.missedHint: Your opponent had just made an error, and you did not take advantage of it.
training.inaccuraciesHint: Smaller errors. More puzzles, but often hard to spot.
training.noneSelected: Select at least one error type.

darstellung.arrows: Arrows for the move played and the best move
darstellung.arrowsHint: Show on the board by default
darstellung.languageHint: Applies to the interface and the AI explanations. Switching also changes the notation; you can still set it separately.

spielen.subtitle: Games against Stockfish (and later live on Lichess).
spielen.soundsHint: Sounds for moves, captures, castling, check, promotion, the start and end of a game and low time.
spielen.autoAnalyseHint: Switches straight to the analysis after the game, from your point of view.
spielen.chatHint: Shows the chat with your opponent on Lichess. When switched off it stays hidden.

errors.boundaryText: This area could not be displayed. Your game has been saved.

chat.title: Question about the position
chat.intro: Ask something about the position shown, e.g. “Why is this move bad?” or “What is the threat here?”. The AI receives the engine evaluation of this position.

errors.noEval: There is no engine evaluation for this position yet. Wait until the engine has calculated it.

hangingPiece.name: Hung material
hangingPiece.text: Your move put a piece or pawn in danger, and your opponent captured it.
hangingPiece.hint: Check before you move: which of your pieces would be undefended or could be captured afterwards?

threatIgnored.name: Missed threat
threatIgnored.text: A piece was already attacked, you did not save it, and your opponent captured it.
threatIgnored.hint: One of your pieces is attacked. Save it, defend it or make a stronger threat yourself.

missedCapture.name: Missed capture
missedCapture.text: An enemy piece was undefended, and the best move would have captured it.
missedCapture.hint: Look closely: is an enemy piece undefended?

mateAllowed.name: Allowed mate
mateAllowed.text: After your move, your opponent could force checkmate.
mateAllowed.hint: Watch your king: which moves could give your opponent a check?

mateMissed.name: Missed mate
mateMissed.text: You had a forced mate and did not play it.
mateMissed.hint: Look for checks – there is a forced mate here.

other.name: Other
other.text: Errors without a simple tactical motif, for example positional errors or combinations.
other.hint: Compare several candidate moves and check the opponent's best reply to each.

lichess.loginFirst: To play live games you first need to sign in to Lichess.
lichess.tooFast: Lichess only allows open seeks via the Board API from rapid upwards (base time + 40 × increment at least 8 minutes).

lichess.fairPlay: During the game all assistance is off – engine, evaluation, hints, coach and AI – even after you send a move. The analysis is only available after the game. Lichess requires this.

live.band: Live game on Lichess: assistance is off
live.ended: Live game over – assistance is back

result.canceled: The challenge to {{name}} is no longer open.
result.failed: The challenge to {{name}} did not work.

lichess.subtitle: Live games against people on lichess.org. All assistance is off during a live game.
lichess.waitingForBrowser: Waiting for the sign-in in your browser …
lichess.desktopOnly: Signing in via the browser only works in the desktop app. Here you can only use a personal token.
lichess.loginHint: Opens lichess.org in your browser. Sign in there and allow Schach-Coach to play games for you (permission “board:play”). Then you can close the browser window.
lichess.tokenStep1: Create a token on Lichess with the permission “Play games with the board API”:
lichess.tokenStep2: Copy the token shown (Lichess shows it only once).
lichess.tokenStep3: Paste it here and click “Check and save”.
lichess.privacy: The token is stored in the system keyring and only sent to lichess.org. Signing out deletes it here and revokes it on Lichess.
lichess.revokeFailed: The token was deleted here but could not be revoked on Lichess. You can delete it yourself at lichess.org/account/oauth/token.

errors.unauthorized: Lichess rejected the token. Check that it has the “board:play” permission and is still valid.
errors.rateLimited: Lichess reports too many requests. Please wait a minute and try again.
errors.unreachable: Lichess cannot be reached. Check your internet connection.
errors.notFound: Lichess does not know this request.
errors.server: Lichess reports a server error. Try again later.
errors.badResponse: The response from Lichess could not be used.
errors.denied: The sign-in was declined on Lichess.
errors.stateMismatch: The reply from Lichess did not match this sign-in and was discarded. Please try again.
errors.timeout: The sign-in took too long. Please try again.
errors.failed: The sign-in did not work. Try again or use a personal token.
errors.keyring: No keyring available: the sign-in only lasts until you close the app.
